title: Freeze the 2026-08-09 TARGET direct-history source inventory

proposal_scope.title: Freeze the 2026-08-09 TARGET direct-history source inventory
proposal_scope.hypothesis: A read-only, hash-recording inventory over the fixed 2026-08-09 runner universe and declared pre-target history sources can produce exactly one authoritative latest-prior-race decision for each of 495 runners, while explicitly failing closed for local, foreign, unavailable, or otherwise unprovable histories.
proposal_scope.null_hypothesis: The declared sources cannot prove one authoritative latest-prior-race decision for every fixed runner, any same-day or future record is required, any source cannot be hash-bound, or any prediction, market, result, ROI, BUY, order, dashboard, notification, or credential path is needed.
proposal_scope.racing_mechanism: The frozen model requires the latest pre-race performance context for each runner. This inventory does not predict; it proves which prior race is authoritative and which exact JRA-VAN SU/SR records may be used later by the already-prepared direct-history adapter.
proposal_scope.target_population: The fixed 495 active runners in the 36 pre-registered 2026-08-09 Sapporo, Niigata, and Chukyo races bound by the EXP025 fold manifest and fixed DU hash.
raw_data_sources: C:/Users/kazup/Data Lab/SE_DATA/2025 and /2026 SU/SR files; exact paths and SHA-256 values are the primary output of this inventory
C:/Users/kazup/OneDrive/デスクトップ/keiba_ai_project/date/raw/全競走馬成績.csv and registered recent-result manifests, read-only and accepted only when their source chronology is explicit
in_scope: Add one read-only source-inventory builder that writes canonical JSON and SHA-256 identities for every external file it actually reads
After a distinct APPROVED_TO_RUN grant, execute one read-only inventory command with no inference or candidate generation
Build exactly one authority row per fixed current horse_id with latest_race_id, latest_race_date, authority source, and explicit contract status
Classify provable JRA history, confirmed no-prior-race, local or foreign latest race, and unprovable authority separately
Enumerate only declared 2025 and 2026 JRA-VAN SU/SR inputs and reject path, hash, duplicate-record, and source-date drift
Keep all 495 runners in the denominator and never substitute an older JRA race for an unprovable latest race
Keep formal_buy false, send_order false, stake zero, dashboard mutation false, notification false, credential access false, and order imports disabled
Run synthetic fixture tests only during APPROVED_TO_PREPARE
lineage_hash_requirements: Every accepted JRA latest race maps to exactly one SU race record and one runner record for that horse
Every accepted latest race date is strictly before 2026-08-09
Every current horse_id has exactly one canonical authority row and no duplicate identity
Every output sets formal_buy false, send_order false, and stake zero
Local, foreign, missing, or unprovable latest histories remain explicit failures and never fall back to older JRA rows
No external source is written or modified
The fixed DU, fold manifest, inventory code, environment manifest, and every external history or authority file read are SHA-256 bound
out_of_scope: Any 2026-08-08 control parity, 2026-08-09 inference, candidate generation, confidence decision, quote, or dashboard generation
Any current odds, popularity, market rank, payout, ROI, result from 2026-08-09, or derivative
Any formal BUY, purchase adapter, notification, nonzero stake, or order transmission
Any historical backtest, model training, refit, calibration, threshold search, candidate reranking, or action optimization
Any mutation of external TARGET or history source files
Any public website acquisition, browser automation, scraping, login, credential, or CAPTCHA interaction
Any silent fallback from a local, foreign, missing, or unprovable latest race to an older JRA record
rejection_gate: Any accepted authority row is dated 2026-08-09 or later
Any current horse_id is missing or duplicated in the authority output
Any external source file is modified
Any latest local, foreign, unavailable, or unprovable race silently falls back to an older JRA race
Any prediction, candidate, odds, popularity, market, payout, ROI, result, dashboard, notification, credential, BUY, stake, or order path is touched
Any preparation command reads a fixed real DU, SU, SR, historical CSV, or recent-result file
Any source file is read without recording and verifying its SHA-256
stop_conditions: Any additional predictive or policy change is required
Any result, market, credential, dashboard, notification, formal BUY, nonzero stake, or order-capable path is encountered
The authority data are not current through the required pre-target as-of date
The fixed DU or fold manifest hash changes
The latest-race authority cannot distinguish a true debut runner from unavailable history
proposal_scope.data_as_of: The target race and runner universe was fixed before this proposal. No real DU, SU, SR, historical CSV, recent-result file, inference bundle, candidate, quote, result, payout, or ROI operation is allowed during preparation. The single real inventory command requires a separate APPROVED_TO_RUN grant.

chronological_fold_design.design: One fixed read-only source inventory; there is no fitting, calibration, policy selection, inference, candidate generation, or ROI evaluation.
chronological_fold_design.target_clock: All authority and history records must have event date strictly before 2026-08-09.
chronological_fold_design.preparation_clock: Only synthetic temporary-directory fixtures are permitted before APPROVED_TO_RUN.
chronological_fold_design.real_data_clock: The exact inventory command runs once after separate run approval and records every file hash before parsing its records.
chronological_fold_design.failure_denominator_rule: Every one of the fixed 495 horse_ids receives an authority row even when its history cannot be proven.

purge_embargo.history_cutoff: No record dated 2026-08-09 or later may be accepted.
purge_embargo.market_firewall: No odds, popularity, market rank, payout, ROI, or derivative may be read or emitted.
purge_embargo.result_embargo: No 2026-08-09 result or post-race field may be read.
purge_embargo.target_selection_embargo: The 495 current horse_ids remain fixed from the pre-registered DU universe.

primary_metric.name: authoritative_history_inventory_completeness
primary_metric.baseline: EXP026 has a deliberately empty fail-closed history source manifest and therefore cannot read real history or generate candidates.
primary_metric.evaluation: Exactly 495 unique authority rows are emitted; every accepted latest JRA race has unique matching SU/SR records; every source read is hash-bound; all unavailable cases are explicit; no future date, silent fallback, prediction, market, or side effect occurs.

notes: Read-only prerequisite inventory for EXP026; no prediction or market operation.
